subject: Supplier activation: COI, PO info, and final onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nicola Ford <nicola.ford@arcwave.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier activation: COI, PO info, and final onboarding checklist

Hi Nicola —

Thanks again for confirming ArcWave as a Redwood supplier. To get your account activated in our procurement system and issue the first PO we need three items from you:

1) Current Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing General Liability (minimum $1M), E&O/Professional Liability, and Cyber coverage.
2) Completed W-9 (or appropriate tax form).
3) Point-of-contact for invoicing and the preferred remit-to address (email + billing contact).

Could you please upload the COI files and W-9 to the shared onboarding folder (linked below) or reply with the attachments? Once we have those we can create a PO and route it to your billing team. Expected timeline after receipt: 2 business days for PO issuance.

Checklist & upload link: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/drive/onboarding/ArcWave-activation-checklist
DocuSign PO (placeholder): https://docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d

If any of the coverages differ from what's requested, flag it in the response and include the policy numbers and effective dates so our procurement team can review.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Vendor Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Nicola Ford <nicola.ford@arcwave.io>

Cc: ArcWave Solutions <procurement@arcwave.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: COI, PO info, and final onboarding checklist

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear list. We're attaching the COIs and our W-9. A couple notes up front:

- General Liability is $2M aggregate (carrier: Meridian Insurance; policy #MG-443210).
- E&O/Professional Liability is in place for $1M.
- Cyber policy is active; the insurer is HarborSec (policy #CY-778900).

Billing contact: Jordan Miles, Billing Manager — jordan.miles@arcwave.io, +1 (212) 555-0199.
Remit-to: ArcWave Solutions, 400 Union Ave, Suite 200, New York, NY 10003.

I'll drop the PDF attachments. Let me know if the policy forms need any additional endorsements or if you need carrier contact info for certificate verification.

Best,
Nicola
Head of Partnerships | ArcWave Solutions
nicola.ford@arcwave.io

Attachments: ArcWave_COI_GeneralLiability_20261101.pdf; ArcWave_Cyber_EO_20261101.pdf; ArcWave_W9.pdf

Nicola — quick thanks. A couple internal next steps so expectations are clear:

- I'll upload the docs to our vendor portal and kick off the verification.
- Laura, can you confirm whether the COI needs an additional insured endorsement for our standard contract? If so we'll request it from ArcWave.
- Once verified, procurement will issue PO AW-2026-1375 and route to Jordan for signature/acceptance.

Nicola — expect a formal PO within 48 hours after verification completes. If anything shows as expired in the COI we'll flag it immediately.

-Stephen (Ben)
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

(Internal note: route DocuSign link to Finance after PO creation.)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Nicola Ford <nicola.ford@arcwave.io>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier activation: COI, PO info, and final onboarding checklist

Thanks, everyone — reviewed the attached certificates. Quick summary and ask: 

- General Liability (Meridian) and E&O look good and within our minimums.
- Cyber policy shows expiration 2026-11-15; that's within 2 weeks — can you confirm auto-renewal or provide evidence of continuous coverage? If not, we'll accept a letter from the carrier or broker confirming renewal is pending.
- We do require the "Additional Insured" endorsement on the General Liability COI for vendor-hosted integrations; please ask Meridian to issue or provide an endorsement page.

Nicola — can you check with your broker and reply by end of day tomorrow? If you prefer, we can accept a broker email copy to procurement@redwoodinference.com. Once we have the endorsement and renewal confirmation, Ben will push the PO and Finance will finalize the DocuSign route.

Laura Bennett
Head of Vendor Risk & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
